reviews.text: great caring service!

I’m so grateful for this place! My regular vet didn’t have any availability, and my cat had been throwing up all night, so I was really worried. They were able to get us in the same day and were so sweet from the moment we arrived.

I had so much anxiety about my cat, and everyone was incredibly patient and reassuring. They were so gentle with her—and honestly, with me too lol. They did X-rays, gave her medication, and thankfully she was back to her normal self by the very next day.

I truly appreciate how well they took care of both of us. Such a kind and compassionate team. ❤️

I brought my sick baby tortoise hatchling. The vet was nice, but when i voiced concerns about him not eating, she did not want to show me or assist me with the proper way of feeding him with a syringe. I purchased their supplements anyway. I kept advocating for more help because he went weeks without eating. She reassured me that he will be fine. After a few unsuccessful days, I called the vet again and gave her an update. She still did not want to attempt to feed him or at least give me tips. My tortoise continued to starve, and eventually died. Though the staff is friendly, they were not helpful in the slightest. I wasted my money going here. They did not treat my tortoise like he a fighting chance.

The entire Northwest Animal Hospital team is exceptional. I first brought my miniature schnauzer, Penny, to Dr. Molly for acupuncture and was so pleased with her approach that I immediately decided she should become our primary veterinarian. She took the time to explain Penny’s condition and treatment options clearly, and Penny has shown tremendous improvement under her care. I’ve also been impressed with the technicians, who work seamlessly with her to provide outstanding care.

This team is great! They are empathetic towards worried owners, knowledgeable, and good prices. They extended my Avas life by 3-4 years and were so gracious when she passed. I am forever grateful for the extra years I  got! I just can't say enough about the staff and Vets. 10 stars! 🌟Take your pets here. You won't regret it!👍
Services provided> Vaccines, dog/cat spay/neuter, kitten toe amputation, ear infections, hookworm, allergies, arthritis, xrays, ultrasounds, senior dog bloodwork and care, congestive heart diagnosis, tests and treatment, and internet price match for maintenance medication.

I love this vet and the staff.
Honest and trustworthy.
Great pricing and flexibility.  Offering reasonable solutions to complex problems.
Their staff is amazing. I feel they are family. We have lots of animals and have gone to different clinics, they are the friendliest and the best. Always quickly available.

Dr. Molly and her team took such great care of Tuesday, my cat. She had a diaphoretic hernia and almost all of her organs were in her chest cavity. They were able to get everything back where it belonged and fix the issue. They explained everything and made sure we were comfortable with her after care before we took her home. I highly recommend them! Thank you all so much!!

The Vets here are awesome! I had an emergency with my dog and they were able to see me in a reasonable amount of time even with a full schedule. The staff was very kind and caring. Both Dr. Vega and Dr. Hartford provided excellent care for our golden retriever who was in a lot of pain. I would trust them with all of my dogs here and plan on coming back.
The doctor and staff all were very compassionate. I should be receiving back my cats results today. I am pretty certain I found the vet I will be staying with.

Returning after 9 year absence due to moving into Spring. After terrible experience with former Vet, I made decision to drive the extra miles for proven competent care, friendly staff, and smaller "home town" environment.   My pet and I are back home with Northwest Animal Hospital!
Dr. Molly and staff they are very friendly and treat your fur babies like their own.

Have brought my pets here since a child. I really trust them and they treat you like family. have gotten surgeries, dentals, etc here. you’re in good hands. I take off work just for them to see my pets when needed. 100/5

I started coming here in February after buying a house nearby, and I truly cannot say enough good things about this team.

My first visit was with my rescue Yorkie, Rupert, who was found on the streets and ended up being diagnosed with severe heartworms. His treatment journey has been incredibly difficult and emotional, especially because I’ve had really painful experiences with a previous vet in the past that left me carrying a lot of fear and distrust.

Because of that, I don’t want to single out one doctor or one vet tech... I’m grateful for the entire team.

Every person here has made me feel heard, supported, and like my dogs genuinely matter. They’ve never made me feel rushed or dismissed, even when there haven’t been easy answers. They take time to explain options, talk through risks and benefits, and help me make informed decisions without pressure.

I have four dogs and one currently going through heartworm treatment, so I’m there far more than I’d like to admit, but every visit reminds me why I trust them.

No one can promise outcomes in veterinary medicine, but finding a team that truly cares and makes you feel like you’re not carrying it all alone means everything.

10/10. I’m so thankful to have found them.

We walked in n immediately took my service dog that was shot 2 the back 2 be examine. Great service n I'm very grateful 4 the way they paid very close attention 2 our concerns 4 my service dog. Thank u very much 4 helping my service dog n giving him the great services
Very friendly, knowledgeable, kind, understanding, & professional staff.  Highly recommend!
My rabbit was brought in for massive fur loss and her problem had to get diagnosed from another vet office. Will not visit again.
Very nice office staff and Dr. O'Bannon  is super with our Diabetic pup.
There’s a reason why I travel from Cypress to have my fur kids seen here. Dr Molly and Staff are very knowledgeable and very compassionate

This clinic are caring and did a great job with my lil girl who has anxiety.  She did let others cut her nails but in the last 2 years has not allowed it and freaks out.  They sedated her and got her nails trimmed and took good care of her.

This is truly the best veterinary clinic I’ve ever been to. From the front desk to the doctor, everyone was calm, patient, and genuinely caring.
They took us in last minute during a very scary situation when I thought I might lose my dog, and they handled everything with such compassion while also helping calm me down.
What impressed me most was how they treated my dog, Lola. She can be uneasy around others, but no one got nervous or overwhelmed—they stayed calm and kind the entire time.
I’m incredibly grateful for the care we received. They truly feel like a blessing. THESE WOMEN ARE GOD SENT ❤️🙏🏽

The staff here are amazing! You can tell they all really love animals and this isn’t just a job for them. I brought My french bulldog here because she was very sick and couldn’t stop throwing up. She ended up getting emergency surgery to remove something she ate that was stuck. Dr. Alex and her team did an amazing job & took such good care of her . Crystara and Jerilyn also helped me & my frenchie alot during the process and with after care & made me feel comfortable during that hard time. Everyone there was very kind & welcoming. It’s been 2 weeks and my baby has healed and is doing great! I couldn’t be more grateful. I’m so happy I came here instead of anywhere else!

Wanted a second opinion on my dog’s tooth extraction, so I came here! Vet was super personable and thorough with check-up, and dental cleaning price was also very affordable for the quality of care. Thanks so much guys!

***UPDATE: 03/04/2026
My very tiny micro teacup Yorkie was spayed and had dental surgery to remove extra teeth. Dr. Molly and staff were amazing. They will always have a special place in our family’s  hearts. Both surgeries were successful because of the talent and expertise at this animal hospital. I would not ever trust any other veterinarian and staff more than I trust Dr. Molly and associates.
First of all, it is true what the reviews say.
I have to give praises to the entire staff. In addition, Shelby, Gabby and Ashley were all amazing! They really do care about your fur-babies. The staff was gentle and provided my pup and myself with a sense of caring. This is the only veterinarian establishment I will ever use from now on.

This place is amazing. All the staff there is super friendly and welcoming. They are also very helpful. They all go above and beyond for you and your pets. One of our dogs is very anxious and doesn’t do well at the vet and they accommodate all of her needs.
I only went there to see my parrot die

I was able to get my sick Quaker parrot an appointment first thing Monday morning. Dr. Alex prescribed 2 medications for pneumonia and within 3 days my bird was back to his old self. I am beyond thankful for the wonderful staff at Northwest Animal Hospital

.

My brother has been a loyal customer to this clinic. Unfortunately we will no longer be returning.

My dog is a part Schnauzer and Poodle, she is 8 months old and had a very  URGENT and CRITICAL emergency. She jumped from the couch and broke her left front leg, she was urinating everywhere and obviously was in extreme pain. When my mother and brother informed the person on the phone they said “we are all booked out”.

So do you seriously expect us to sit with her all day with no medication to soothe her pain nor answers until monday? Absolutely insane this place has no moral value of animals who are in NEED of URGENT treatment.

The staff was very nice and loving to my furr baby!
Vaccine prices are very reasonable. Thank you Northwest Animal Staff!
Never had any problems. They always answer my questions.and I love the fact that I can retrieve the records electronically

I am writing this review after significant reflection and with a heavy heart.

I brought my bird to this clinic seeking care, clarity, and compassion. What I experienced instead was confusion, poor communication, and a lack of responsiveness at moments when urgency and empathy mattered most.

During my visit, I experienced physical contact by a doctor without clear consent or adequate explanation. When I later raised concerns, they were minimized rather than meaningfully addressed.

I was left trying to navigate a frightening situation without guidance or reassurance from the very people entrusted with my pet’s care.

Ultimately, my bird passed away.
I believe that with appropriate dosing, clearer communication, and greater compassion, the outcome may have been different. I will never know for certain, and that uncertainty is part of the harm.

What I do know is that I left this experience feeling unheard, unsupported, and deeply let down during an already painful time.

The clinic staff appeared overextended and conditioned to managing disorder rather than providing coordinated care. Concerns were deflected instead of resolved, and accountability felt absent at every level.

I chose not to pursue legal action. That decision does not erase what happened, nor does it remove the responsibility of sharing my experience honestly.

Losing a pet is devastating. Losing trust in the people meant to help you protect them makes that loss heavier. Based on my experience, I cannot recommend this clinic to anyone who expects clear communication, respect for boundaries, and compassionate care, especially when outcomes are uncertain and emotions are already high.

The entire staff was extremely helpful and made me and my pet Sparkles feel welcomed. Everyone was informative and caring to mine and Sparkles needs. This will now be my go-to place for all my pet's needs. Highly recommend.
Disgusting service two hour wait the doctors don’t care. They did not take very good care of my dog nor me nor my son.

Our experience overall was not great. I understand that having a guinea pig is an exotic animal. We rescued a guinea pig and needed to have him neutered. This clinic was referred to us by a friend. The vet that performed the surgery seemed fine, but there were complications after his surgery involving a hernia. We went back to the vet to find out what the lump was  (because we aren’t veterinarians and didn’t know)  and was told that it was either a fatty tumor or we could do exploratory surgery, but she did not feel like it was a hernia. We gave him medicine that was prescribed and it helped some, but didn’t fix the issue. There were phone calls to the vet and a few visits….. finally it was determined (months later) that he had a hernia and by the time surgery was scheduled it was basically too late. My family is heart broken and frustrated at the lack of knowledge from this clinic. We feel that his life was lost based on their inexperience. From seeing other negative reviews I’m sure there will be a rebuttal…. But please keep searching for another vet when looking for your precious guinea pig or other exotic animal.

Update: I figured there would be an extensive elaboration justification to my review….. grant I glance at it because I know it was a big cya explanation…NEVER was exploratory surgery recommended….. so please stop with that! Completely false, regardless of what someone wrote down in his notes, we were not encouraged to do that. We are very responsible pet owners and you clearly know from the charges we are willing to do anything to save a life.  Reviews are meant to inform consumers to a personal experience. We followed the advice of a doctor and clearly that wasn’t correct.  We also tried to schedule Oliver’s surgery sooner and were told that surgeries weren’t performed then. As you know Oliver wasn’t showing signs of illness prior to the day his surgery was scheduled from our what we knew, as we aren’t doctors and didn’t know what to look for. So frame this however suits your narrative….. Oliver’s health was mishandled and as his owner I have the right to caution other Guinea pig owners without you blasting his medical record and what you were told we were told all over the internet. Perhaps the next time a new client meets with you, Dr. Molly regarding the initial surgery, YOU are the doctor that actually preforms it. I have no doubt that there will be more feedback and aggression towards my update….. and so be it. I’m being honest and I feel I owe it to Oliver’s life to hold steady in that.

Dr MOLLY made me feel at ease immediately as soon as I came in with my noodle Mr. Tickles. Im so glad to have found an exotic vet close to me!! I don’t have a lot of sick FERRET experience so I was really worried about my guy after he had gone downhill quickly. She performed surgery to remove an impaction in his stomach and he is home and recovering. I am so grateful for their team! I’ll be back when he’s all better for a check. ❤️‍🩹🥰
Been coming here since the 80’s when I was a kid with our family pets. Always affordable and compassionate, my pets have always been well take care of here ❤️
I’ve been taking my animals here since 1999. The vets and staff are always so friendly and patient with all our animals. I’ve never had a bad experience here

I highly recommend this vet clinic for numerous reasons.  Their whole team was so friendly and knowledgeable and I had a sense of peace being there with my fur baby, Winston.  I was already a nervous wreck because he is my fur child and I was worried about complications, post surgery because of his breed (English Bulldog).

Unfortunately the vet clinic I tend to use couldn't resolve the issues Winston was having, so I had to look elsewhere. I called around and emailed several vet clinics to inquire about their surgery services.  I received ballpark quotes that were exceedingly expensive for elongated soft palette and stenotic nares surgery.  Then I remembered a friend of mine had taken her bulldog here for a different type of surgery and she highly recommended Northwest.

After speaking with the office manager, Jerilyn, I had a sense that I had found the right place even though I had not yet even been to their clinic.  Upon meeting Dr. Molly, I was so much more at ease and could tell she knew what she was doing, not to mention she has a strong passion for what she does as a veterinarian.  Some veterinarians I have met previously over the years, have not been so warm and compassionate.  I didn't feel rushed during Winston's consultation or like I was wasting her time.

Ashley, the front receptionist, was delightful and so kind when I went to pick up my baby after his surgery.  She explained all of the post op medicine with such patience and understanding.

I could go on and on, but let me just sum up and say look no further!  This vet clinic is where I will be taking my fur babies from now on.  Regardless that I live over an hour away and work for a veterinarian affiliated company.

P.S. - My total bill was even less than what I was initially ballpark quoted, so that was definitely an added bonus.  Other vet clinics would've charged 3x times the amount that I ended up paying.

I've been bringing my cats here for years but now I'm a first-time dog-owner and the doctor and staff were above and beyond helpful! A full exam and explanation of what is available vaccine and test wise, even an estimate of what to expect when it's time for her to get spayed.

Most appreciated, they provided as much advice as I asked for on training and raising a high-energy dog, and even how to make my cats less angry about her breathing in their space.

Lady Bug loved all the attention she got from the staff and wasn't ready to go home without her new friends when we left. Thank you guys and we look forward to seeing you again!
My dog Honey went in for routine vaccinations, but had also had issues because she ate acorns. Thorough exam and recommendations were made. Honey is just fine now. Great, honest and loving care.
They took such good care of my boy in an emergency situation. Very grateful for their help and would recommend to anybody who loves and cares about their animals
I 've going to NWAH for 15 yrs, with 2- 4 dogs. They care and are kind with all my dogs. And me....lol

Dr. Alex Vega and her assistant came out to my home and diagnosed my 2-3 week old baby chicks and healed them up in no time!!! Couldn’t be anymore grateful to the kindest vet ever and her amazing assistant!!! If you need a vet you can trust be sure to book an appointment with northwest animal hospital they have an amazing team that will get you taken care of!
The staff is always friendly and helpful -- with both the human and canine clients! :-)
I've been going to Northwest since 2010 and the Vets & Staff is always friendly, knowledgeable and compassionate.
I highly recommend Northwest Animal Hospital. Dr. Molly Bannion is a very good vet. Staff are very friendly, helpful, and caring.

Northwest Animal Hospital has been such a great experience; from the Pre-op to the Post-op. Dr. Molly and staff have been outstanding. They made us feel like we’ve have known each other for years and our furry child was the only patient they had to care for. They answered all our questions and concerns. We definitely recommend you taking your fury kids to them.
I bring all my fur babies here always have a pleasant experience. The doctors always give the best service and advice.

If you’re looking for a team that takes their time and goes above and beyond to make YOU and your dog comfortable, this is the place to be. Dr. Molly and her team are incredible! My dog recently had surgery and reopened her wound. They were able to quickly squeeze us into their schedule right before closing time to make sure my dog was okay. For as busy as they are, from the doctors to the vet tech to their receptionist, they truly take their time to thoroughly examine your pet. This place is genuinely a one of a kind vet hospital and I couldn’t be more thankful for them.
Dr Molly and her staff are the best!!!

We’ve been loyal customers at this vet clinic since 2021, but unfortunately, we’ll be moving on and taking our five dogs elsewhere. The main reasons are increasing prices and disappointing customer service.

When we first started coming here, the pricing was reasonable. However, over the past two years, the cost of vaccines and services has become nearly unattainable. We understand inflation, but the yearly price hikes have been excessive. For context, here are the prices we paid for a large breed dog:
•	7/10/2021: $330.71
•	5/31/2022: $388.62
•	6/12/2023: $213.50 (a dip)
•	6/26/2024: $491.45

With five dogs, it adds up quickly. We’ve since found a different clinic offering the same vaccines and services for much more affordable prices.

Customer service, especially with the vet techs and front desk, has also been frustrating. From 2022 to 2024, two of our dogs’ records were mixed up in their system. Despite repeatedly asking for it to be corrected, the issue wasn’t resolved until 2025—three years later. This caused ongoing issues every visit, including having to repeatedly provide our own shot records to avoid confusion.

There have also been small but important mistakes. One time, the vet tech forgot to include a medication dosage, and we had to call and drive back to fix it. Another time, one of our small dogs tested positive for heartworm, and we were quoted nearly $1,000 for treatment. We were shocked—another clinic quoted us just $250 for the same treatment. We can’t understand the drastic difference.

Appointment scheduling is also problematic. Even if you have a set appointment time (say, 3:00 PM), multiple people can be scheduled for the same time, and whoever checks in first gets seen first. This has led to unpredictable wait times, ranging from 15 minutes to over an hour—even when we arrived on time. Given the cost of visits, this kind of system feels unacceptable.

That said, there have been positives. One of our dogs gets anxious around other pets and people, and the staff was very accommodating in helping him feel comfortable. The main vet is kind and professional, and we appreciate the help we’ve received over the years. However, we’ve noticed a constant turnover in front desk and tech staff, and the quality of service varies greatly depending on who’s working.

We share this to be transparent—not to discourage others, but to give an honest account of our experience. We’re thankful for the care our pets received here in the past, but for us, it’s time to move on due to the cost and inconsistency in service.

Everyone was very friendly and attentive. I feel that I got good quality care for my snake at a fair price. I would absolutely return to this practice and I intend to recommend it to family and  friends! 😊 …

I adopted a ferret from an animal shelter about a week ago and brought him here today for a free health exam. I should start by saying that the ferret was an owner surrender, so he was already named by his previous owner. His name is “Shmule” which I recently learned is the Jewish version of the name “Samuel”. It’s an uncommon name, but i didn’t bother changing it due to him responding to that name when called.  I respect other people’s cultures and beliefs so i thought the name was pretty unique. While i was waiting in the waiting room to be called back, i overheard the girls at the front counter repeating his name over and over out loud and laughing hysterically. I felt as if they were making a mockery of his name and it was incredibly disrespectful and inappropriate. When we were called to the back i politely confronted the girl, and she claimed that they weren’t laughing at his name, but her co workers were making her say it because she has a speech impediment and that they were laughing at her. I was offended because in the moment it felt like they were making fun of the pronunciation of his name, and instead of mocking it and laughing about it they simply could’ve just asked me how to say it… and if they were going to laugh about it, they could’ve waited until i left or at the very minimum made sure i didn’t hear it. Playing around with your co workers at the receptionist desk infront of paying customers wasn’t very professional in my opinion, but besides that I didn’t have any issues with the doctor or the care that my ferret received.

This review is based on 4+ years of medical care

Dr. Molly and her staff helped us through the learning curve of having a 2 year old doberman as our 1st dog ever, Covid and a myriad of personal distrust for doctors in general.  I'm so deeply grateful that I was told about her practice.  I'll never see another vet....ever, let me try to explain why.

It isn't just that Dr. Molly is so academically accomplished, nor that she has experience with just about every critter large or small, or that I've never had to go to a strange orthopedist or cardiologist, or that she shares her knowledge by bringing interns into her practice, or demonstrates her generosity by volunteering for free spay/neuter events and gives her time to The Rescue for PTSD, supports FFA or even that she is so gentle, kind, & understanding of human guardian quirks but still no nonsense when it comes to her patients' care.  It's because at the core of it all, she and her staff put the animals' care 1st.  I once asked her why she likes the surgery portion of her practice so much.  She answered that it's bc surgery is when she can most directly/immediately address/fix what ails her patients.  It's clear in every interaction that she is looking out for her patients 1st and foremost.

This extends to the entire staff.  I often overreact to everything that may be wrong with Baelin.  They are always kind and patient.   In the beginning I think I asked for help with nail trimming/ear cleaning a zillion times but was never made to feel bad about it. Thank you Ashley for always being so steady when I call in a panic (which is 9/10 times).  Hearing what the issue is and scheduling an appointment based on the actual issue not my flustered ramblings.  Jerilyn, I believe has some magic that allows her to just KNOW what's needed & when.  Moises, is Baelin's favorite (even dresses like him sometimes) despite every time we see him, it involves temperature taking in the bum and generally some other unpleasant procedure.

If Northwest Animal Hospital is so awesome why did it take so long to write this review?  It's because they have made all the bad, scary moments manageable.  It's because I feel so safe trusting them that I don't dwell on what is or could go badly due to illness.  Time has just flown by.  Baelin is 7 now and end of life is a real thing, especially with an off Holter reading.  I'm remarkably calm about it all because I know that he has THE BEST medical team available who will give him the best care & giving me the best advice to ensure he has the highest quality of life possible.

This review doesn't come close to reflecting the regard and gratitude I feel for the staff.  However, I hope it helps folks understand the level of exemplary competence, kindness and dedication that is Northwest Animal Hospital.
---------------------
Update:  Baelin now needs an injection for his arthritis.  This morning was the 1st time for me to do it.  I had a full on panic moment with cold sweats and shaking hands.   Jerilynn was there....a calm, reassuring voice, confirming the steps and not for one moment making me feel anything but supported and capable.
Additionally, Dr. Molly has traditional medical knowledge in her wheelhouse, she also has what I would equate to a human DO's breadth of knowledge so you can rest assured ypur animal is getting the best, most well rounded care available.
If you're looking for a doctor...a medical team to care for your pet, who is focused on their well being over all else;  if you're searching for folks who will be knid and genuine, this is the place for you.

Our 34 year old red earred slider turtle stopped eating.  She's done that before, but this time it was for a much longer period.  None of our old tricks worked.  On top of that, there was something weird in the tank that we've never seen, and from googling it looked like it could be a parasite.

We've never taken it in to a vet, but we called Northwest Animal Hospital.  The girl that answered the phone (I sadly don't recall her name) was so extremely helpful.  We told her about the parasite, so she gave us her cell to send a picture.  She showed it to the vet that specializes in reptiles and called us right back.  The vet was also unfamiliar with what it was.  After some discussion we made an appointment.  As we were about to hang up she asked about the water temperature.  We said it was 68.  She said that was too low, and to put a heater in there to get it up to 74 or so.  We bought one right away, and 3 days later the turtle was back to its old self.

We will be recommending this vet to our friends who need one for their furry and unfurry pets!
Friendly and helpful staff.  Dr. Molly was wonderful in helping us find a treatment plan that worked best for our family.

I honestly can’t say enough nice things about this place. Molly and her staff were so amazing and so compassionate when dealing with a little 1.4lb panleuk kitten.

In rescue we come across a lot of veterinarian offices and this place far exceeded my expectations and I intend to come here for all my rescue needs moving forward. Thank you guys for being so amazing and look forward to doing more business with you in the future

I will be returning to this vet hospital. The staff was very helpful and gentle. Dr. Molly quickly identified the issues my puppy was having with her eye and provided options for treatment plans easily. I was able to be scheduled within a day of calling them about multiple concerns, on my first call to their hospital without even being placed on hold. (Kind of unheard of!)

Very safe and comforting environment. The staff was very helpful, patient, and understanding. They provided helpful information to answer our questions and concerns before even asking. Would recommend 10/10. Just schedule an appointment as they are very busy!

Neighborhood friends recommended Northwest Animal Hospital and we’ve appreciated the courteous, knowledgeable and reasonably priced services (they provide estimates so there’s no surprises).  We have recommended them to several neighborhood area pet owners as well.
Always a pleasure to see our vet 💗 and they always make sure we get what we need for our fur babies. Staff is very patient and explains everything in great detail ☺️ …
Staff was friendly and caring. So happy I found this place.

They are absolutely the best! My dog is not the easiest to deal with but they honestly do an amazing job at working with him and handling all his temper tantrums! He recently got his nail trim done and they said he did amazing which is surprising because he usually terrifies all the groomers🤦🏼‍♀️ I’m so glad that i finally have a place that knows how to deal with him❤️

My rooster had a gnarly case of bumble foot and I was very impressed with how NWAH handled it. They didn’t jump the gun on surgery and instead said let’s try daily soaks for a week to see if the infection can be removed without invasive surgery. Unfortunately we eventually had to go with surgery, but I admired that they went down that route only as a last resort. Many vets will try to preemptively sell you on surgery (for financial benefit) but I can confirm that the vets here are not like that. They are experienced and make decisions with the animals best interest in mind.

The surgery was ultimately a success and the communication on what to expect and post care was clear and precise.

I’m sorry that you felt the need to give us a 1 star review. However, the only client we have by your name we have not seen with any pets since 2019. If you had a recent experience that you were unhappy with, please contact us to specify what happened so that we can grow from it.

I would like to take the time out to thank Northwest Animal Hospital for their support and service. Our little guy is not feeling well and Northwest Animal Hospital was able to see him quickly. I would like to give a big thanks the their front of house staff who greeted us and got us going. Thank you to the Vet Laura and Vet Tech I believe his name was Moses. I am sorry if I missed the name. Thank you guys for helping me and my family as we nurse Herbert back to great health.
Thank you for helping my dog tiger when he had broke his tooth.

I've gone to the NW Animal Hospital with a number of cats, all homed strays, over the years. They've invariably been helpful and friendly, supportive when it's called for (in the case of pets at end of life), even when the animals are their least pleasant selves.  I'll be going back if any of my critters need a vet again.
Been going here for years and they take wonderful care of both my dogs ! Whole staff is great
1000% recommend this clinic every time I call they are the most helpful. Today I had the pleasure to speak with Ashley who was nothing but kind and helpful!
The staff is friendly and efficient. They know my dog and treat her with love. They are honest and straightforward when it comes to a diagnosis and treatment.

Thank you Dr Molly and team for the emergency care given to Zoey today! She is always in good hands with her general care and today she had an emergency and it was met with the same great attentiveness! They put me and my fur baby at ease with their knowledgeable care. Thanks to the team you guys rock!!

I’ve used northwest several times in the past with no real issues.
Yesterday I found a pigeon that had been hit on the side of the road FM 1960.  I immediately called northwest explaining situation and was told Dr Molly does treat domestic birds and would treat this pigeon, if I took financial responsibility, which I agreed to.

When I got to the clinic at my appt time, I told the attendant again I found the injured bird on the side of the road.
Within a few minutes they asked to take the pigeon in for Dr. Molly to look at.

They then called me to the back area and said Dr Molly had evaluated the pigeon and asked me again “was I willing to take financial responsibility for this pigeon and nurse it back to health” if they performed X-rays, etc, to determine the injuries, which I said absolutely.
